SELECT T.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID JOIN BOK_BOOKSET T3 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID WHERE T.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' AND T.BUSI_TYPE = '02' AND T3.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND T.SHARE_AMT IS NOT NULL and T.FINPROD_ID in
#{assetid}
AND T.SHARE_AMT != 0
AND ((TRADE_MARKET = '01' AND T.SETTLE_DATE <= to_date(#{qrydate},'yyyy-MM-dd')) --银行间根据交割日 OR (TRADE_MARKET != '01' AND T.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{qrydate},'yyyy-MM-dd')) --交易所根据交易日 )
GROUP BY T3.BOOKSET_ID, T.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(DECODE(T.PS, 'T01', 1, 'T02', -1, 'T04', 1, 'T23', -1) * T.Share_Amt) != 0
